key_phrases: platform shift from coding to machine learning
analysis.reasoning: The company reported record-breaking revenue with massive year-over-year growth in Data Center and Networking. Management expressed extreme confidence in the Blackwell architecture, noting that demand is 'staggering' and exceeds supply. While there are minor concerns regarding gross margin compression (to low 70s) during the Blackwell ramp and potential supply constraints in gaming, the overall outlook is overwhelmingly positive due to the structural shift toward AI factories and inference-time scaling. The CEO was direct in addressing technical shifts, though slightly evasive on specific future sequential growth projections ('We guide one quarter at a time').
